summary: Black Rock Forest lookout of chestnut poles on a Revolutionary-era signal site; removed in the 1970s; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS record describes the lookout itself. No build date, staffing or fire history appears in any source read. The '20-foot' figure is used as the tower's size; height_m is omitted because the source does not say it is height. Elevation conflict left open: FFLOS gives the site 1,433 ft (437 m), Black Rock Forest gives the summit 1461 ft, and the 2010 blog also says 1,461 ft. The story flags the difference. Coordinates differ between the FFLOS record (41.39092, -74.02125) and the New York list (41.38968, -74.02397); the brief's coordinates were not changed. Access 'restricted' rests on one 2010 blog post and the forest's own rules were not read; check them before publishing. The Karnig 1966 Black Rock Forest PDF returned no text and was not used.
